diagrams.name: Document opening, sharing, and saving
diagrams.ascii:
Workbench documents
|
|-- EditorService
|   `-- openEditor(resource, options)
|       |-- resolve editor type
|       |   `-- FileEditorInput [ordinary text file]
|       |
|       `-- choose editor group
|           `-- EditorGroupView
|               |-- tabs / active editor
|               `-- EditorPanes
|                   `-- TextFileEditor
|                       |-- input: FileEditorInput
|                       |   |-- resource URI
|                       |   |-- retained model reference
|                       |   `-- resolve() ---------------------------+
|                       |                                           |
|                       `-- CodeEditorWidget                         |
|                           |-- model ------------------------------|----+
|                           `-- view state                          |    |
|                               |-- cursor / selections             |    |
|                               `-- scroll position                 |    |
|                                                                   |    |
|-- TextFileEditorModelManager                                       |    |
|   |                                                               |    |
|   |-- resolve(resource) <------------------------------------------+    |
|   |   |-- resolution pending? -> join existing work                     |
|   |   |-- model loaded? ------> reuse it                                |
|   |   `-- otherwise ----------> create and resolve                      |
|   |                                                                    |
|   `-- TextFileEditorModel [one per resource]                            |
|       |                                                                |
|       |-- resource / encoding / last known file metadata               |
|       |-- dirty / saving / conflict / error                            |
|       |                                                                |
|       |-- textEditorModel: TextModel <----------------------------------+
|       |   |-- text buffer
|       |   |-- edit history / document version
|       |   `-- content changes
|       |       |-- attached editors update their views
|       |       `-- compare with saved version
|       |           |-- different -> dirty
|       |           `-- restored by undo -> clean
|       |
|       |-- resolve
|       |   |-- dirty or saving? -> preserve current contents
|       |   |-- initial backup? -> restore contents
|       |   `-- TextFileService.readStream --------------------------+
|       |       `-- decoded text -> create/update TextModel          |
|       |                                                           |
|       `-- save <--- explicit save / automatic save                 |
|           |                                                       |
|           |-- pending save                                        |
|           |   |-- same version -> join                            |
|           |   `-- newer version -> queue                          |
|           |                                                       |
|           |-- save participants                                   |
|           |   `-- may edit TextModel before saving                 |
|           |                                                       |
|           |-- snapshot current text + version                     |
|           |   `-- TextFileService.write ---------------------------+
|           |                                                       |
|           `-- result                                              |
|               |-- success                                         |
|               |   |-- update file metadata                        |
|               |   |-- version unchanged -> clean                  |
|               |   `-- newer edits -> retain current dirty state   |
|               `-- failure                                         |
|                   |-- changed externally -> conflict               |
|                   `-- write error -> edits remain unsaved          |
|                                                                   |
|-- TextFileService <------------------------------------------------+
|   |
|   |-- readStream
|   |   `-- provider bytes -> decode -> text buffer
|   |
|   |-- write
|   |   `-- text snapshot -> encode -> provider bytes
|   |
|   `-- FileService
|       |-- resource URI
|       |   `-- scheme selects filesystem provider
|       |       |-- file:
|       |       `-- extension schemes, including git:
|       |
|       |-- read -> provider capabilities determine read operation
|       `-- write
|           |-- check for external modifications
|           `-- provider writes contents or reports failure
|
`-- TextModelResolverService
    `-- model references [shared document lifetime]
        |-- FileEditorInput retains a reference while in use
        |-- disposing the input releases its reference
        `-- last reference released
            |-- dirty / resolving -> wait
            |-- reference acquired again -> keep model
            `-- safe to dispose -> release document model

diagrams.name: Source Control and Git
diagrams.ascii:
SOURCE CONTROL AND GIT
======================

File changes ------+
Explicit refresh --+--> Repository ---- resource groups ----> ExtHostSCM
Git operations ----+    |                                    |-- provider / group registration --+
                        |                                    `-- resource splices ---------------+
                        |                                                                        |
                        |                                                                        v
                        |                                                                  MainThreadSCM
                        |                                                                        |
                        |                                                                        v
                        |                                                           MainThreadSCMProvider
                        |                                                           |-- identity / root
                        |                                                           |-- groups / resources
                        |                                                           `-- change notifications
                        |                                                                        |
                        |                     SCMService.repositories -----+                     |
                        |                     focus / selection -----------+---------------------+
                        |                                                  |
                        |                                                  v
                        |                                              SCMViewPane
                        |                                              |-- tree / list
                        |                                              |-- decorations
                        |                                              `-- resource actions
                        |                                                  |             |
                        |                      +------- Stage -------------+             |
                        |                      |                                         |
                        |                      v                                         |
                        |              CommandCenter.stage                               |
                        |                      |                                         |
                        `-- Repository.add <---+                                         |
                            `-- git add -> status refresh                                |
                                `-- resource groups update again                         |
                                                                                         |
                  +----------------------------- Open Changes ---------------------------+
                  |
                  v
          ResourceCommandResolver
          |-- single file -> vscode.open
          |-- conflict -> merge editor
          `-- comparison -> vscode.diff [COMMAND] -> EditorService -> DiffEditorInput
                                                                          |        |
                                                               original URI        modified URI
                                                                          |        |
                                                                          +---+----+
                                                                              |
                                                                              v
                                                               TextModelResolverService
                                                               |-- reuse loaded document
                                                               `-- resolve missing contents
                                                                              |
                                                                              v
          GitFileSystemProvider <----- git: ------------------------------ FileService
          |-- readonly revision contents                                      |
          `-- Repository.buffer                 File-system provider <--------+ file:
              `-- git show                      `-- working-file contents
                  |                                 |
                  +----------------+----------------+
                                   |
                                   v
                           TextFileService
                           `-- decode each resource
                                   |
                         +---------+---------+
                         |                   |
                         v                   v
                 original TextModel   modified TextModel
                         |                   |
                         +---------+---------+
                                   |
                                   v
                           TextDiffEditorModel ------> TextDiffEditor / DiffEditorWidget
                           |-- original reference      |-- compare models
                           `-- modified reference      |-- original code editor
                                                       `-- modified code editor
                                                           `-- editing / undo / save


[URI]       Resource identity shared by SCM entries, providers, and document models.
[COMMAND]   Shared command dispatch connects UI actions to handlers.
